calls.statement:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 14 AS first_week, 17 AS last_week
),
range_start AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week
),
weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN weeks w
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    CROSS JOIN params
    CROSS JOIN range_start
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
    JOIN dim_store st   ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id || '-' || d.fiscal_week) AS store_weeks
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((d.fiscal_year), (d.fiscal_year, cs.region))
)
SELECT ty.region, ty.store_weeks, ty.net_sales AS this_year, ly.net_sales AS last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM lfl_sales ty
CROSS JOIN params
JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.region IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year
ORDER BY ty.region NULLS FIRST

WITH rng AS (SELECT * FROM (VALUES (DATE '2025-07-28', DATE '2025-08-24'),(DATE '2026-08-03', DATE '2026-08-30')) t(a,b)),
dups AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, f.line_no, COUNT(*) c, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) ids, COUNT(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) loads
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN rng ON f.sale_date BETWEEN rng.a AND rng.b
  GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
SELECT COUNT(*) dup_keys, SUM(c) rows_in_dups, MAX(c) max_c, SUM(ids) ids, SUM(loads) loads FROM dups

WITH rng AS (SELECT * FROM (VALUES (DATE '2025-07-28', DATE '2025-08-24'),(DATE '2026-08-03', DATE '2026-08-30')) t(a,b)),
mine AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.v) net
  FROM (
    SELECT f.sale_date bd, f.store_key, f.net_amount v FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE p.category<>'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, r.store_key, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key WHERE p.category<>'ZZ Test') n
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=n.store_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.bd
  JOIN rng ON n.bd BETWEEN rng.a AND rng.b
  WHERE s.store_id<900
  GROUP BY 1,2),
ctl AS (
  SELECT c.store_id, d.fiscal_year, SUM(c.net_sales) net FROM rpt_daily_store_sales c JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=c.business_date JOIN rng ON c.business_date BETWEEN rng.a AND rng.b
  WHERE c.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT COALESCE(m.store_id,c.store_id) store_id, COALESCE(m.fiscal_year,c.fiscal_year) fy, m.net mine, c.net ctl, ROUND(COALESCE(m.net,0)-COALESCE(c.net,0),2) diff
FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c ON m.store_id=c.store_id AND m.fiscal_year=c.fiscal_year
WHERE ABS(COALESCE(m.net,0)-COALESCE(c.net,0))>0.5 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH cs AS (SELECT store_id, store_name, region, format, open_date, close_date FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id<900),
wk AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(s.v) net, COUNT(*) n
  FROM (
    SELECT f.sale_date bd, st.store_id, f.net_amount v FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND st.store_id<900
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, st.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key WHERE p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND st.store_id<900) s
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=s.bd
  WHERE (d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 14 AND 17) OR (d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 14 AND 17)
  GROUP BY 1,2,3)
SELECT cs.store_id, cs.store_name, cs.region, cs.format, cs.open_date, cs.close_date,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2026/27' THEN net END)) ty, COUNT(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2026/27' THEN 1 END) ty_wks,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN net END)) ly, COUNT(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN 1 END) ly_wks,
  ROUND(100*(SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2026/27' THEN net END)/SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN net END)-1),1) pct
FROM cs LEFT JOIN wk ON wk.store_id=cs.store_id GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

FROM rpt_daily_store_sales c JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=c.business_date
